title: Dia Browser waitlist dock
description: A closing serif line and the cream-arc waitlist bar, built to wrap a whole page: on desktop the arc stays docked at the bottom of the window through every section, slips down and shrinks its black pill to 85% once you start scrolling, then grows back to full size, small print and all, as it settles under the closing heading. Phones show the heading and the bar in place.
notes: put the page's sections (hero first) inside it as children; the footer goes after it
pair with diabrowser-hero's docked prop so the hero's own bar hides from lg
CSS only: a sticky last child plus scroll() and a named view timeline (timeline-scope); without support the bar just docks at full size
needs the page itself to scroll: no overflow-hidden ancestors
name: diabrowser-waitlist-dock

props.name: children
props.description: the page sections the bar rides along with (hero to the last section before the closer)

props.name: heading
props.description: the closing serif line the bar settles under

props.name: cta
props.description: the black CTA on the arc
